item.title: Building a Twin-ITX Cluster
item.description:
I am building a cluster that includes a Turing Pi (a mini-ITX cluster board), alongside a normal mini-ITX system. I wanted to put both of these in a single chassis to save space, which is possible with a “dual mini-itx”, or “twin-itx” chassis. This article covers most of the chassis I discovered.

As of writing, I have made a purchase (I went with the MyElectronics chassis).

1U

1U chassis will not fit a Turing Pi. So, I did not evaluate these.
